description.zh:
数据集ID数组，以英文逗号分隔。
><notice>该参数会转换为对应的问数资源ID进行授权，所以当传入的cubeId不存在对应的问数资源时，会报错问数资源不存在，请确保cubeId正确性></notice>
description.en:
An array of dataset IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas.
><notice>This parameter is converted to the corresponding Q\&A resource ID for authorization. If a \`cubeId\` does not correspond to an existing Q\&A resource, an error is reported that the Q\&A resource does not exist. Ensure that the \`cubeId\` is correct.></notice>

description.zh:
过期时间，默认七天。
格式：2099-12-31
description.en:
The expiration time. The default is seven days.
Format: 2099-12-31

description.zh: 分析主题ID数组，以英文逗号分隔。
description.en: An array of analysis subject IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas.

description.zh: 问数资源ID数组，以英文逗号分隔。
description.en: An array of Q\&A resource IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas.

description.zh:
操作类型。取值如下：
- 0：新增授权
- 1：删除授权
description.en:
The operation type. Valid values:

- 0: Grant authorization

- 1: Delete authorization

description.zh:
用户ID数组，以英文逗号分隔。
><notice>单次请求的用户id数 * （问数资源数 + 分析主题数）不能大于100。></notice>
description.en:
An array of user IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas.
><notice>The number of user IDs × (the number of Q\&A resources + the number of analysis subjects) in a single request cannot exceed 100.></notice>

title.zh: 批量管理小Q问数的授权
title.en: Batch Management of Smart Q\\\\\\&A Authorizations

descriptions.zh: 用于批量管理智能问数的授权，重复新增授权会视为新增操作；重复删除授权会默认跳过，也不会记录审计日志。
descriptions.en: Manages authorizations for Intelligent Q\&A in batches. Granting an existing authorization is treated as a new grant operation. By default, an attempt to delete an authorization that does not exist is skipped and no audit log is recorded.
